decision.reason: [ev-5e95ef039bdc] is a one-line changelog entry saying Argo CD now "support[s] --include-templates for labels" in its Kustomize integration. It reads as Argo CD gaining support for a flag that Kustomize already has. It does not say that Argo CD added its own `--include-templates` flag, and Kustomize is an external tool, not an Argo CD component. The entry does not name the setting operators use in Argo CD to turn this on, such as an Application spec field under `kustomize` or an `argocd` CLI flag. Without that, I can't confirm or correct the subject. The change type "added" also can't be confirmed without the PR or docs. The render validators were inconclusive because the chart fetch failed.
